investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-16T09:03–09:11Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the pod requesting a kata.peerpods.io/vm resource could not be placed because 2 eligible nodes reported insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. Because the pod never became schedulable, the agent was never created, and the eval runner produced zero evidence — all four required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are missing.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that match the pod's affinity/selector. The remaining 4 nodes are excluded by node affinity or selector rules and cannot be used even via preemption. As a result, every remote-agent pod submitted during this eval window was stuck Unschedulable for ~142–143 seconds before the probe timed out, preventing agent creation and producing no evidence output. This is an infrastructure-layer scheduling constraint failure localized to the remote-agent feature in the production-api environment; no evidence of a user-traffic or broader service incident is present in the supplied packet.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-16T09:03–09:11Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the pod requesting a kata.peerpods.io/vm resource could not be placed because 2 eligible nodes reported insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. Because the pod never became schedulable, the agent was never created, and the eval runner produced zero evidence — all four required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are missing.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that match the pod's affinity/selector. The remaining 4 nodes are excluded by node affinity or selector rules and cannot be used even via preemption. As a result, every remote-agent pod submitted during this eval window was stuck Unschedulable for ~142–143 seconds before the probe timed out, preventing agent creation and producing no evidence output. This is an infrastructure-layer scheduling constraint failure localized to the remote-agent feature in the production-api environment; no evidence of a user-traffic or broader service incident is present in the supplied packet.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Eval Failure: Kubernetes Kata/PeerPods VM Capacity Exhausted — All Three Remote-Agent Checks Unschedulable
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api on 2026-07-16 with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes had zero available kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity (2 nodes showed Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm, 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector), causing every remote-agent pod to remain unscheduled for ~142–143 seconds before the eval timed out. Because no agent pod was ever scheduled, the eval runner could not create a remote agent, and consequently zero required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) were collected, violating the expected-output contract defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) exhausted its schedulable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource slots at the time of the eval run. Of the 6 available nodes, only 2 are configured to serve kata.peerpods.io/vm workloads, and both reported Insufficient capacity; the remaining 4 nodes did not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector constraints. With no node able to schedule the pod and preemption finding no victims, the eval runner's createAgent call (run-status-probes.mjs line 1918) blocked until the probe timeout (~148 s), returning no evidence. This is an infrastructure-layer scheduling failure localized to the remote-agents VM pool, not a code defect in the eval runner or contract definitions. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence; this is an eval-layer failure.
